errors.quote: it computes the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) of an array in $\log_2 t$ layers instead of $t^2$ operations
errors.problem: The comparison sets a count of layers against a count of operations. The fast procedure takes $\log_2 t$ layers of $t/2$ butterflies and twiddles each, so $O(t\log t)$ operations, against $O(t^2)$ for the direct sum. The page's own later sentence ('for $O(t\log t)$ operations in all') gives the correct comparison. Also, the layers compute the transform with its outputs in bit-reversed order ($B_tF_t^-$ in the paper, lines 2864-2870), not the DFT array in natural order. The page states this further down.
